'''Qazadi''' was a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] who lived around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he traveled to [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] to both verify the safety of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] blackmail files stored in [[Avrak Villachor]]'s vault and to possibly "recruit" new resources for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. He was something of a recluse during [[Festival of Four Honorings]] preferring to view the sites from his private room in [[Marblewood Estate]]. During the [[Marblewood Estate heist|heist]] led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on the mansion, Qazadi was killed by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] disguised as the deceased [[Eanjer Kunarazti]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
